RoleGrants

/-- A role assigned to the user on this repository, or on all of them,
carries `perm`. -/
def RoleGrants (db : tables.Db) (user repo : U64) (perm : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ ra ∈ db.role_assignments.val, ra.user_id = user ∧
    (ra.repository_id = some repo ∨ ra.repository_id = none) ∧
    ∃ r ∈ db.roles.val, r.id = ra.role_id ∧ Carries r.permissions.val perm

/-- The rule names this user: directly (`user`, `service_account`) or through
a group the user is a member of. -/
def PrincipalMatches (db : tables.Db) (p : tables.Permission) (user : U64) : Prop :=
  ((nats p.principal_type.val = lit "user" ∨ nats p.principal_type.val = lit "service_account") ∧
    p.principal_id = user) ∨
  (nats p.principal_type.val = lit "group" ∧ (user, p.principal_id) ∈ db.members.val)

spec.name: OnRepo
spec.code:
/-- The rule targets the repository, or the project that owns it. -/
def OnRepo (db : tables.Db) (p : tables.Permission) (repo : U64) : Prop :=
  (nats p.target_type.val = lit "repository" ∧ p.target_id = repo) ∨
  (nats p.target_type.val = lit "project" ∧ ProjectOf db repo p.target_id)

spec.name: IpOk
spec.code:
/-- The rule's `allowed_cidrs` condition holds for the client IP: no
condition, or a known IP inside one of the ranges. -/
def IpOk (p : tables.Permission) (ip : Option net.IpAddr) : Prop :=
  p.allowed_cidrs = none ∨
  ∃ cs a, p.allowed_cidrs = some cs ∧ ip = some a ∧ ∃ c ∈ cs.val, inCidr c a = true

/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::permission::check_repository_action]:
    Source: 'src/permission.rs', lines 135:0-150:1
    Visibility: public -/
def permission.check_repository_action
  (db : tables.Db) (client_ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user_id : Std.U64)
  (repository_id : Std.U64) (action : Slice Std.U8) (is_admin : Bool) :
  Result (core.result.Result Bool AppError)
  := do
  if is_admin
  then ok (core.result.Result.Ok true)
  else
    let b ← tables.Db.fails db tables.Query.RepositoryAction
    if b
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err AppError.Database)
    else
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8 ]))
      let owner ← permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id s
      let b1 ← permission.any_applicable db client_ip user_id repository_id
      let decided ←
        if b1
        then
          permission.any_applicable_grants db client_ip user_id repository_id
            action
        else
          do
          let b2 ←
            permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id action
          if b2
          then ok true
          else
            let s1 ←
              lift (Array.to_slice
                (Array.make 5#usize [ 97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8 ]))
            permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id s1
      if owner
      then ok (core.result.Result.Ok true)
      else ok (core.result.Result.Ok decided)

macro "normalize_literal" : tactic => `(tactic| (

theorem nats_eq_iff (xs ys : List U8) : nats xs = nats ys ↔ xs = ys := by
  exact List.map_inj_right (fun _ _ heq => u8_eq_iff _ _ |>.2 heq)

@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (left right : Slice U8) :
    strs.bytes_eq left right ⦃ out => out = decide (nats left.val = nats right.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold strs.bytes_eq
  step*
  · simp_all [nats_eq_iff]
    intro heq
    exact ‹¬ left.val.length = right.val.length› (congrArg List.length heq)
  · rename_i hlen
    have hlen' : left.val.length = right.val.length := by simpa using hlen
    unfold strs.bytes_eq_loop
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (left.val.zip right.val)
      (fun pair => decide (pair.1 ≠ pair.2)) id (fun _ _ => false) true
      (strs.bytes_eq_loop.body left right) ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
    · intro out hout
      have hz := zip_all_eq left.val right.val hlen'
      rw [List.all_eq_not_any_not] at hz
      have hs := search_bool _ _ false true out hout
      simp only [nats_eq_iff]
      rw [hs]
      have : (left.val.zip right.val).any (fun pair => decide (pair.1 ≠ pair.2)) =
          (left.val.zip right.val).any (fun pair => !decide (pair.1 = pair.2)) := by
        congr 1
        funext pair
        exact decide_not
      rw [this]
      cases ha : (left.val.zip right.val).any (fun pair => !decide (pair.1 = pair.2)) <;>
        simp_all
    · intro index hi
      unfold strs.bytes_eq_loop.body
      i5h_step [List.length_zip, hlen', List.getElem_zip]

@[step] theorem any_eq_spec (xs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (action : Slice U8) :
    strs.any_eq xs action ⦃ out => out = decide (Carries xs.val (nats action.val)) ⦄ := by
  unfold strs.any_eq strs.any_eq_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search xs.val
    (fun entry => decide (nats entry.val = nats action.val)) id (fun _ _ => true) false
    (strs.any_eq_loop.body xs action) ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro out hout
    have hs := search_any _ _ _ hout
    simp only [id_eq] at hs
    rw [hs]
    apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
    simp [Carries, List.any_eq_true]
  · intro index hi
    unfold strs.any_eq_loop.body
    i5h_step

theorem masked_eq (width shift : Nat) (left right : BitVec width) :
    left &&& (BitVec.allOnes width <<< shift) = right &&& (BitVec.allOnes width <<< shift) ↔
      left >>> shift = right >>> shift := by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
    intro index hi
    by_cases hbound : shift + index < width
    · have hbits := congrArg (fun bits : BitVec width => bits.getLsbD (shift + index)) heq
      simpa [BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft,
        Nat.le_add_right, hbound, hi] using hbits
    · simp [BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_of_ge, Nat.le_of_not_gt hbound]
  · intro heq
    apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
    intro index hi
    by_cases hshift : shift ≤ index
    · have hbits := congrArg (fun bits : BitVec width => bits.getLsbD (index - shift)) heq
      simp only [BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, Nat.add_sub_of_le hshift] at hbits
      simp [BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft, show ¬ index < shift by omega, hbits]
    · simp [BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft, show index < shift by omega]

theorem masked_eq_div {ty : UScalarTy} (left right : UScalar ty) (shift : Nat) :
    left.bv &&& (BitVec.allOnes ty.numBits <<< shift) =
      right.bv &&& (BitVec.allOnes ty.numBits <<< shift) ↔
      left.val / 2 ^ shift = right.val / 2 ^ shift := by
  rw [masked_eq, ← BitVec.toNat_inj]
  simp only [BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight, UScalar.bv_toNat, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

@[step] theorem cidr_contains_spec (range : net.CidrRange) (ip : net.IpAddr) :

theorem rule_overrides_role (db : tables.Db) (ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user repo : U64) (a : Slice U8)
    (hp : ∃ p, Applicable db ip user repo p)
    (hn : ∀ p, Applicable db ip user repo p →
      ¬ Carries p.actions.val (nats a.val) ∧ ¬ Carries p.actions.val (lit "admin"))
    (hr : ¬ RoleGrants db user repo (lit "admin")) :
    permission.check_repository_action db ip user repo a false ≠ ok (.Ok true) := by
  have owner_false (admin : Slice U8) (hadmin : nats admin.val = lit "admin") :
      permission.assigned_role_has db user repo admin = ok false := by
    apply eq_ok_of_spec
    apply WP.spec_mono (assigned_role_has_spec db user repo admin)
    intro out hout
    have hout' : out = decide (RoleGrants db user repo (lit "admin")) := by
      simpa only [hadmin] using hout
    simpa only [decide_eq_false hr] using hout'
  have applies_true : permission.any_applicable db ip user repo = ok true := by
    apply eq_ok_of_spec
    apply WP.spec_mono (any_applicable_spec db ip user repo)
    intro out hout
    simpa [hp] using hout
  have grants_false : permission.any_applicable_grants db ip user repo a = ok false := by
    apply eq_ok_of_spec
    apply WP.spec_mono (any_applicable_grants_spec db ip user repo a)
    intro out hout
    have hnone : ¬ ∃ rule, Applicable db ip user repo rule ∧
        (Carries rule.actions.val (nats a.val) ∨ Carries rule.actions.val (lit "admin")) := by
      rintro ⟨rule, happ, hgrant⟩
      exact hgrant.elim (hn rule happ).1 (hn rule happ).2
    simpa only [decide_eq_false hnone] using hout
  intro hsuccess
  unfold permission.check_repository_action at hsuccess
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hsuccess
  obtain ⟨failure, hfailure, hsuccess⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hsuccess
  cases failure
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, lift, bind_ok] at hsuccess
    rw [owner_false _ (by simp [nats])] at hsuccess
    simp only [bind_ok, applies_true, reduceIte] at hsuccess
    simp [grants_false] at hsuccess
  · simp at hsuccess

end artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution

theorem nats_inj {a b : List U8} : nats a = nats b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction a generalizing b with
    | nil => cases b <;> simp_all [nats]
    | cons x xs ih =>
      cases b with
      | nil => simp [nats] at h
      | cons y ys =>
        simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
        rw [ih h2, (u8_eq_iff x y).2 h1]
  · rintro rfl; rfl

@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    strs.bytes_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (nats a.val = nats b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold strs.bytes_eq strs.bytes_eq_loop
  dsimp only
  split
  · rename_i hne
    simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    have : a.val.length ≠ b.val.length := by simpa [Slice.len] using hne
    simp only [nats_inj]
    exact (decide_eq_false (fun h => this (by rw [h]))).symm
  · rename_i hlen
    have hl : a.val.length = b.val.length := by simpa [Slice.len] using hlen
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (List.zip a.val b.val) (fun p => decide (p.1 ≠ p.2)) (fun r : Bool => r)
      (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
    · intro r hr
      rw [search_bool _ _ _ _ _ hr]
      have hz := zip_all_eq a.val b.val hl
      simp only [nats_inj]; rw [← hz, List.all_eq_not_any_not]
      simp only [ne_eq, decide_not]
      cases (List.zip a.val b.val).any fun p => !decide (p.1 = p.2) <;> rfl
    · intro j hj; unfold strs.bytes_eq_loop.body; i5h_step

theorem mask_eq {w s x y m : Nat} (hx : x < 2 ^ w) (hy : y < 2 ^ w) (hs : s ≤ w)
    (hm : ∀ i, m.testBit i = (decide (s ≤ i) && decide (i < w))) :
    (x &&& m = y &&& m) ↔ x / 2 ^ s = y / 2 ^ s := by
  constructor
  · intro h; apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro j
    rw [Nat.testBit_div_two_pow, Nat.testBit_div_two_pow]
    by_cases hj : j + s < w
    · have := congrArg (·.testBit (j + s)) h
      simp only [Nat.testBit_and, hm] at this
      simpa [hj] using this
    · have hw : 2 ^ w ≤ 2 ^ (j + s) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (by omega), Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (by omega)]
  · intro h; apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro i
    rw [Nat.testBit_and, Nat.testBit_and, hm]
    by_cases hi : s ≤ i
    · have := congrArg (·.testBit (i - s)) h
      simp only [Nat.testBit_div_two_pow, Nat.sub_add_cancel hi] at this
      rw [this]
    · simp [hi]

theorem dec_mask {ty} {n a i i1 : UScalar ty} {w s m : Nat} (hx : n.val < 2 ^ w) (hy : a.val < 2 ^ w)
    (hs : s ≤ w) (hm : ∀ j, m.testBit j = (decide (s ≤ j) && decide (j < w)))
    (hi : i.val = n.val &&& m) (hi1 : i1.val = a.val &&& m) :
    decide (i = i1) = (n.val / 2 ^ s == a.val / 2 ^ s) := by
  have : i = i1 ↔ n.val / 2 ^ s = a.val / 2 ^ s := by
    rw [← mask_eq hx hy hs hm, ← hi, ← hi1]
    exact ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h⟩
  by_cases h : n.val / 2 ^ s = a.val / 2 ^ s <;> simp [this, h]

theorem mask_zero (w : Nat) : ∀ j, (0 : Nat).testBit j = (decide (w ≤ j) && decide (j < w)) := by
  intro j; simp

theorem mask_full (w : Nat) : ∀ j, (2 ^ w - 1).testBit j = (decide (0 ≤ j) && decide (j < w)) := by
  intro j; simp [Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one]

theorem mask_shift (w k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ w) :
    ∀ j, (((2 ^ w - 1) <<< k) % 2 ^ w).testBit j = (decide (k ≤ j) && decide (j < w)) := by
  intro j
  rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one]
  by_cases h1 : j < w <;> by_cases h2 : k ≤ j <;> simp [h1, h2] <;> omega

@[step] theorem contains_spec (c : net.CidrRange) (ip : net.IpAddr) :
    net.CidrRange.contains c ip ⦃ b => b = inCidr c ip ⦄ := by
  unfold net.CidrRange.contains
  rcases c with ⟨n | n, p⟩ <;> rcases ip with a | a <;> simp only [inCidr]
  all_goals (try simp only [WP.spec_ok])
  all_goals (split <;> i5h_steps)
  · have hp : p.val = 0 := by scalar_tac
    rw [show 32 - min p.val 32 = 32 by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 32) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) le_rfl (mask_zero 32)
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl)
  · have hp : 32 ≤ p.val := by scalar_tac
    rw [show 32 - min p.val 32 = 0 by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 32) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) (by omega) (mask_full 32)
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl)
  · have hp : p.val < 32 := by scalar_tac
    have hx : x.val = 32 - p.val := by scalar_tac
    have hm : mask.val = ((2 ^ 32 - 1) <<< x.val) % 2 ^ 32 := by rw [mask_post, U32.size_def, U32.numBits]; rfl
    rw [show 32 - min p.val 32 = x.val by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 32) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) (by omega) (hm ▸ mask_shift 32 x.val (by omega))
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and])
  · have hp : p.val = 0 := by scalar_tac
    rw [show 128 - min p.val 128 = 128 by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 128) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) le_rfl (mask_zero 128)
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl)
  · have hp : 128 ≤ p.val := by scalar_tac
    rw [show 128 - min p.val 128 = 0 by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 128) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) (by omega) (mask_full 128)
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and]; rfl)
  · have hp : p.val < 128 := by scalar_tac
    have hx : x.val = 128 - p.val := by scalar_tac
    have hm : mask.val = ((2 ^ 128 - 1) <<< x.val) % 2 ^ 128 := by rw [mask_post, U128.size_def, U128.numBits]; rfl
    rw [show 128 - min p.val 128 = x.val by omega]
    exact dec_mask (w := 128) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) (by omega) (hm ▸ mask_shift 128 x.val (by omega))
      (by rw [i_post, UScalar.val_and]) (by rw [i1_post, UScalar.val_and])

theorem rule_overrides_role (db : tables.Db) (ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user repo : U64) (a : Slice U8)
    (hp : ∃ p, Applicable db ip user repo p)
    (hn : ∀ p, Applicable db ip user repo p →
      ¬ Carries p.actions.val (nats a.val) ∧ ¬ Carries p.actions.val (lit "admin"))
    (hr : ¬ RoleGrants db user repo (lit "admin")) :
    permission.check_repository_action db ip user repo a false ≠ ok (.Ok true) := by
  intro h
  have := post_of_ok (check_spec db ip user repo a) h rfl
  rcases this with h1 | ⟨_, p, hpa, hc⟩ | ⟨hne, _⟩
  · exact hr h1
  · exact (hn p hpa).elim (fun hn1 hn2 => hc.elim hn1 hn2)
  · exact hne hp
